arguments.sql: SELECT c.Name AS Country, cl.Language AS Language FROM country c JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage WHERE CountryCode = c.Code)
